checklist: Keep this Mac offline. Don't log in to anything from it until it's cleaned.
From another device (your phone), change your passwords: email first (it resets everything else), then banking, then anything saved in this Mac's browsers.

Log out everywhere: stolen browser cookies keep sessions alive after a password change. Use 'Sign out of all devices' for Google, Microsoft, Discord, Steam, Telegram (Settings > Devices > Terminate all), social media.
Crypto: move funds to a NEW wallet created on a clean device. Treat every seed phrase this Mac has ever seen as burned.
Turn on 2FA with an authenticator app (not SMS) for important accounts.

Strongly consider erasing the Mac and reinstalling macOS (back up your documents, not your apps): stealers often drop more malware. At the least, remove anything you don't recognise from System Settings > General > Login Items.
Look the file up on VirusTotal from another device: https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/9f2c41d077ab03e5c1b6f28e4d9a0c73b5e18d2f6a4c90b7e3d1f5a8c2b6e41b

steps: Kill NitroGen-Free.exe: it's still frozen. Killing it ends it for good and keeps the evidence.
Sign out of every site in Chrome: stolen cookies let someone be you without a password. Signing out makes them useless.
Change your Discord password, then log out all other sessions in Discord's settings.

The Discord webhook is the stealer's own mailbox, not yours. You can report it to Discord (Trust & Safety, at dis.gd/request): Discord deletes webhooks used for stealing, and then nothing more reaches the thief through it.
The Telegram bot is the stealer's own, not yours. You can report it to Telegram (abuse@telegram.org, with the bot's token): Telegram shuts such bots down.

sections.title: What ABA did
lines: Caught on Fri Nov 27 2026 at 14:02:07, the moment it opened the bait (stopped 120 ms after).
Done: Froze it and 1 process(es) it started
Done: Cut its internet
To answer it, type one of these in Terminal, with sudo in front (or answer ABA's first popup about it):
aba kill dead  it's malware: end it (it stays cut off)
aba trust dead  it's yours: undo everything and stop alerting about it
aba resume dead  not sure: let it run again, without trusting it
